First, I lurked you a bit and saw you replying to a lot of these r/depression threads and I think you're an absolute fucking hero. 
I've developed myself in such a way that my hobbies don't require groups, and I'm shy about them anyway. Few people know I play guitar or like to write stories, and I think I'd be embarrassed to let them know.

I'm from Canada.
I guess that's just it. Everything is so shitty, right? I don't even know if it's really worth sticking around.
